decision.explanation: All four values (1,243, 1,192, 1,290, and 924) are explicitly stated in the original sources for the population of Vermillion Township, though they refer to different years and locations. The first three values (1,243, 1,192, and 1,290) pertain to Vermillion Township, Dakota County, Minnesota, as reported in the 2000, 2010, and 2020 censuses respectively. The value 924 refers to Vermillion Township in Vermillion County, Indiana, as reported in the 2010 census. Since the question does not specify a year or disambiguate between the two townships, all valid referents and complementary answers are preserved.
